assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite sheet for a premium 2.5D urban fighting game, NOT a poster. Design a completely new look for MURAT, an adult broad-shouldered Turkish-German construction worker and boxer, age 35, strong handsome expressive face, short dark textured hair, neatly trimmed beard, muscular heavyweight believable anatomy. Costume: weathered burnt-orange sleeveless workwear vest over fitted charcoal compression shirt, dark slate reinforced work trousers with subtle reflective seams, rugged brown safety boots, off-white professional boxing hand wraps. Premium detailed hand-painted game render, realistic worn cloth and leather, confident graphic silhouettes, warm amber key light from upper left and subtle cool cyan rim from right. Three-quarter side view facing RIGHT, fully visible head to boots, fixed orthographic camera. Exactly TEN isolated full-body figures in a strict FIVE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS grid on genuinely TRANSPARENT background. Every cell equal size with generous empty margins; no figure crosses a cell boundary, no cropped limbs or feet. Consistent identity, same face, same clothing, same proportions in every pose. Read order left-to-right top-to-bottom: 1 combat idle with hands up, weight balanced; 2 high two-arm boxing guard; 3 low crouching combat guard; 4 airborne jump with knees tucked; 5 fully extended lead straight punch with rear hand guarding; 6 rear cross punch with hip rotation; 7 low lead-leg front kick with rear supporting foot planted; 8 powerful head-height rear roundhouse kick with clear supporting leg; 9 recoiling from a face hit; 10 victory pose with wrapped fists raised. Each fighter occupies about 80 percent of cell height, all grounded poses feet on the same relative baseline. No floor, no shadows outside silhouette, no scenery, no lettering, no labels, no cell borders, no weapons, no duplicated extra limbs. Ultra clean transparent alpha edges. Landscape sheet, render at the highest practical resolution, ideally 2560 by 1024 or larger.

Character: MURAT, exact identity/costume/materials of attached reference. Turkish-German male heavyweight boxer, 35, short textured dark hair, trimmed beard, muscular broad shoulders; weathered burnt-orange sleeveless work vest over a charcoal compression shirt, slate reinforced work trousers, rugged brown safety boots, off-white boxing hand wraps.
Production animation extension. Exactly TWENTY separate full-body fighters in a strict FIVE COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS grid, read left to right top to bottom. Use the reference ONLY for the exact character identity, face, costume and painted 2.5D style. Same right-facing orthographic side view, proportions, materials and colors in every cell. Transparent background, no scenery, floor, shadows, text or labels. Equal empty gutters; no cropped head, hand, foot or extended limb. Each cell ONE figure. Keep common body scale; do NOT enlarge crouching/fallen bodies.
ROW 1, cells 1–5: five consecutive frames of a natural low boxing shuffle WALK. 1 lead heel contact; 2 weight sinks over lead foot; 3 rear foot passes underneath pelvis; 4 passing foot just above ground, NOT high knee; 5 opposite foot contact. Knees never rise above mid-calf in these walking frames. Hands remain in guard. ROW 2, cells 1–5: 6 final sixth walk frame returning rear foot toward balanced stance; 7 lead jab PREPARATION, lead fist pulled back slightly; 8 lead jab RECOVERY, lead elbow deeply bent and fist RETURNED near chin, not an extended punch; 9 rear cross WIND-UP, rear shoulder and hip coiled backward; 10 rear cross RECOVERY, rear fist near cheek and body settling to guard.
ROW 3, cells 1–5: 11 tight HORIZONTAL lead HOOK with bent elbow and torso twist; 12 VERTICAL rear UPPERCUT with fist rising above face and elbow beneath fist, unequivocally an upward punch, NOT a horizontal hook; 13 kick CHAMBER with lead thigh raised, knee bent, shin hanging down; 14 kick RECOVERY with kicking leg folded backward underneath hips, knee lower than chamber, foot retracting toward ground; 15 strong forward KNEE strike, knee extended toward opponent, rear support foot planted.
ROW 4, cells 1–5: 16 low CROUCH BLOCK with both forearms guarding face; 17 BODY HIT reaction folding torso over ribs; 18 FALL backward with feet off ground, body diagonal; 19 GROUNDED horizontally lying defeated, whole body head to boots inside cell; 20 GET UP from one knee with hand pushing on floor.
Preserve every costume detail and the exact same face as reference. No alternate outfits, no extra limbs, no duplicated figures. Distinct readable actions exactly in the listed slot order. Highest practical resolution, landscape 5x4 sheet ideally2560x2048 or higher.
